overall_score.description: 1-4 in half steps: 1 below senior, 2 senior, 3 staff, 4 senior staff+

answers_the_question.description: False when the story does not actually address what was asked

summary.description: The verdict in 2-4 sentences: how a staff-level interviewer would read this answer and the single biggest thing to fix

strengths.description: What already reads as staff-level, each grounded in a quote or detail from the answer

issue.description: What is missing or weak relative to the staff bar

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt from the answer it refers to, or empty

fix.description: Exactly what to add, cut or reframe

follow_ups.description: 2-4 probing questions a staff interviewer would ask next about this story

stronger_outline.description: Markdown bullets: a tighter Situation, Task, Action, Result, Reflection outline of the SAME story, using only facts the candidate gave; put [add: ...] where a fact is missing

assessed.description: False when the answer gives nothing to judge this on
